newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti opts not to sell Benecke unit.
newsitem.headline: Conti opts not to sell Benecke unit.

text.p: German tyre producer Continental AG said on Wednesday that it and DG Bank have decided not to sell off Benecke-Kaliko, a car parts maker in which Continental and DG have major stakes.

Benecke, which mainly produces plastic interior furnishings for cars, has seen positive developments in its business and earnings rose in 1996 above the 1995 level of 15 million marks, Continental said in deciding to hold onto the group.
The unit, which is a part of Continental's "Conti-Tech" group, has annual sales of about 630 million marks and employs about 2,200 workers.

Continental owns 50.1 percent of Benecke, which was merged in December 1993 with Goeppinger Kaliko GmbH, while DG Bank owns 49.9 percent. The decision announced on Wednesday was a reversal of earlier plans to sell the unit.
